title: Illustration Anatomy
slide_intent: Derive curves and corners from an existing symbol so a new figure feels related even when the subject changes.
strategic_value: Instacart can extend the geometry of the carrot into figures, clothing and objects without repeating the entire mark.
demonstration: The green and orange symbol stands beside an illustrated figure carrying groceries. Fine callouts identify round geometry and sharp corners on the illustration.
practical_value: Compare the silhouette of a new figure with the symbol, then choose where a rounded contour or a sharp turn should articulate the pose.

content_islands.name: Geometric reference
content_islands.spec: Set the brief at left and isolate the Instacart symbol below it with room around the outline.

content_islands.name: Annotated figure
content_islands.spec: Give the right side to the person carrying goods. Attach fine blue leaders to the round detail near the hand and to a sharp detail near the foot.
